Name: More Dresser Variety
Author: Dragoon23
Description:
[size=3][b]More Dresser Variety[/b]
[/size][size=3]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Adds 10 different dressers that each hold different things. [/size]
[*][size=3]Controller support to use trigger/shoulder buttons to move through tabs. Works with Furniture Catalogue tabs too.[/size]
[*][size=3]Can change order of Tabs, Dresser Prices, and which Dressers to Enable.[/size]
[*][size=3]Keyboard hotkeys to move through tabs.[/size]
[*][size=3]Can Quick Stack and Favorite slots. [/size]
[*][size=3]Grid UI[/size]
[*][size=3]HoverText/Tooltips for each Tab[/size]
[*][size=3]Can Manually sort items into different tabs. Works with all modded items.[/size]
[*][size=3]Can extract single/bulk items from dresser [/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Weapon Dresser[/size]
[*][size=3]Tools Dresser[/size]
[*][size=3]Bait & Tackle Dresser[/size]
[*][size=3]Gems & Minerals Dresser[/size]
[*][size=3]Produce Dresser[/size]
[*][size=3]Fish & Beach Forage Dresser[/size]
[*][size=3]Resources & Craftable Dresser[/size]
[*][size=3]Artifacts, Trinkets, & Misc Dresser[/size]
[*][size=3]Animal Produce & Cooked Foods Dresser[/size]
[*][size=3]Furniture Dresser[/size]
[/list]
[size=3][b]Note: Only empty dressers/fish tanks and sling shots/fishing rods with no ammo/bait/tackle equipped will be allowed into Dresser.
Changing Prices/Which Dressers to enable requires a game restart from desktop.

[/b][/size][size=4][b]Before disabling a dresser, be sure to remove Everything from it.[/b][/size]

How To Use Quick Stack, Favorite, Single/Bulk Extract:
[/size]
[size=3][b]To Quick Stack: [/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Open the Dresser and press the Quick Stack Key. [/size]
[*][size=3]Default is Left Trigger for Controllers and Left Control for Keyboards.[/size]
[/list]
[size=3][b]To Favorite:[/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Open the Dresser, move cursor over the slot, and press the Favoriting Button. [/size]
[*][size=3]There will than be a light gray filter over the slot which indicates its been favorited. [/size]
[*][b][size=3]NOTE: This will favorite the Slot, not the item. [/size][/b]
[*][size=3]Default is Right Trigger for Controllers and Tab for Keyboard. [/size]
[*][size=3]Saves upon falling asleep.[/size]
[/list]
[size=3][b]To Single/Bulk Extract: [/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Single Item: Default is Right click for Keyboard and X button for controller to take out a single item. [/size]
[*][size=3]Bulk Extract: Default is hold Left Shift and right click for Keyboard. For controller Default is tap DPadRight to toggle Bulk Extract and use X button.[/size]
[/list]
[size=5]
How To Use Manual Sort:
[/size]
[size=3][b]To Manual Sort: [/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Open the Dresser and select the Tab. [/size]
[*][size=3]Move cursor over item from your inventory that you want manually sorted into tab.[/size]
[*][size=3]Click Manual Sort button. Default is G for Keyboard and DPadDown for Controller.[/size]
[*][size=3]Works with all modded items.[/size]
[/list]
[size=3][b]To Select a Different tab: [/b]
[/size][list][size=3][/size][*][size=3]To select another tab, repeat above.[/size]
[/list]
[size=3][b]To enable Vanilla Sort: [/b]
[/size][list][size=3][/size][*][size=3]Click tab that item was manually sorted into, move cursor over item in inventory, and click Manual sort button.[/size]
[/list]
[size=3][b]Manual sorting list Save Location: [/b]
[/size][list][size=3][/size][*][size=3]MoreDresserVariety/MDV_ManualSortingList/MDV_ManualSortingList.json[/size]
[/list]

[/size][size=5]Known issues:[/size][size=3]

[b]Regarding modded items that equip ammo or hold things like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5382]Item Bag[/url]﻿ disappearing: [/b]
"Dressers are not designed to hold any items that can hold/equip other items. This is why I added checks to block all vanilla items like fishing pole with bait, furniture that isn't empty, slingshot with ammo, etc. Dressers will only accept vanilla items if they're empty and completely unequipped.

I don't want to keep updating the mod every time a mod adds a new item like that. Unless I can find a less manual way to do this without needing constant updating, tentatively marking this as not fixing.

Edit: On further testing with Item Bag, I found that no error popped up and while it doesn't display properly in the dresser (it will show zero items is in it in the dresser), items are still stored safely in it when retrieved. Though I would still caution using it with Dresser since again, it's not designed to hold items that can hold other items."[/size]
